selection_rationale: Six live claims; source archive is public and contains formulas/figures; theoretical Claims 1-3 admit CPU clean-room audits. Claims 4-6 require separate public-data/protocol availability checks before empirical work.

claim_1_outcome.scope: exact finite binary r=2 enumeration under independent positive non-uniform sampling; not a general proof
claim_1_outcome.negative_control: unweighted residual correction has absolute bias 0.0026

claim_2_outcome.scope: finite three-stratum Gini U-statistic, interior/non-clipped budget allocation; not a general asymptotic theorem proof
claim_2_outcome.negative_control: raw prediction-residual allocation objective 0.6565200975 exceeds sqrt(s) objective 0.6288614429

claim_3_outcome.scope: finite bounded HT-functional CRN coupling under H1/H2; not a proof of full U-statistic CLT or CI coverage
claim_3_outcome.negative_control: fixed learned-policy error violates H2 and retains RMS scaled coupling difference near 0.95
